Compare the current source census and regenerated contents with committed indexes.
files.why: Missing, changed or deleted sources must make stale documentation visible in CI.
files.when: Changing drift detection, missing-output diagnostics or snapshot handling.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_doc_indexes.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Parse OPERATIONS with AST and generate the operations registry and empty tool inventory.
files.why: Published operation metadata must match source without importing the application.
files.when: Changing registry schema, generated metadata or drift checking.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_maintenance.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Generate static file indexes and the provenance-tagged repository dossier.
files.why: A portable source map helps maintainers locate implementation and operating details.
files.when: Changing census exclusions, file cards, parser extraction or generated documentation.
files.how_to_read: census → code_inventory → render → write; REVIEWED holds curated explanations
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_doc_indexes.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Plan or archive older prompt and memory sections while retaining current context.
files.why: Long workflow logs need bounded active files without losing earlier records.
files.when: Changing archive thresholds, section parsing or safeguards around writes.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_maintenance.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Expose GitHubExplorer, GitHubPanel and the package version.
files.why: Consumers import the reusable screen and standalone host from this facade.
files.when: Changing public imports or the release version.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Parse launch options, validate repository context and select JSON catalog or TUI mode.
files.why: Both console-script aliases and python -m use this entrypoint.
files.when: Changing CLI flags, startup validation or error exit behavior.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Host GitHubPanel in a standalone Textual application.
files.why: Keeping the host separate allows other Textual apps to embed the panel.
files.when: Changing standalone startup, branding or exit behavior.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Parse local gh help, derive repository setting arguments and define curated Git shortcuts.
files.why: The UI needs searchable local commands without executing aliases or extensions.
files.when: Changing help parsing, external-command classification or discovery errors.
files.how_to_read: load_catalog → help_text → parse_catalog; flags_from_help; QUICK_ACTIONS; git_commands
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_catalog.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Declare runtime operation metadata records and return independent copies.
files.why: Maintainers can document behavior and remediation without triggering discovery or execution.
files.when: Changing the public operation inventory, source anchors or remediation guidance.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_maintenance.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Compose file browsing, CLI controls, shortcuts, directional navigation, settings and confirmation.
files.why: One screen connects discovery and execution while keeping explicit user confirmation.
files.when: Changing arrow navigation, quick actions, asynchronous refresh, previews or host integration.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_panel.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Prepare shell-free argv, run child processes and read GitHub repository metadata, trees and blobs.
files.why: Execution shares repository context, bounded capture, cancellation and timeout semantics.
files.when: Changing argument handling, subprocess cleanup, output decoding or environment isolation.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_runner.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Provide network-free repository fixtures for UI tests.
files.why: Automatic startup reads must never access a real account in tests.
files.when: Changing shared UI repository fixtures.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_repository_panel.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Test nested help parsing, alias classification, flags and the built-in-only discovery calls.
files.why: Fixtures enforce discovery without executing discovered commands.
files.when: Changing catalog parsers or discovery subprocess arguments.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_catalog.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Test CLI help/version, validation, JSON export, timeout handling and standalone hosting.
files.why: CLI modes must select the correct behavior and preserve useful error exits.
files.when: Changing startup options, errors, JSON shape or standalone screen integration.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Test deterministic generation, stale sources, file deletion/addition, exclusions and collisions.
files.why: Fixture repositories check index correctness without application execution.
files.when: Changing source census, generated dossier contracts or public-data guards.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_doc_indexes.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Test archival preservation and refusal, fenced headings, copied metadata and generated registries.
files.why: Maintenance must preserve workflow content and keep public metadata synchronized.
files.when: Changing log rotation or operation registry generation.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_maintenance.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Verify tree expansion, spatial arrow focus, native dropdowns and text editing.
files.why: Arrow navigation must not activate commands or discard native editing behavior.
files.when: Changing navigation in the panel, settings or confirmations.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_navigation.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Exercise embedded UI confirmation, argument editing, capture, clipboard, stopping and catalog races.
files.why: Textual pilots verify user actions before mocked command execution.
files.when: Changing screen events, confirmation boundaries or threaded completion callbacks.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_panel.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Verify repository identity, trees, previews, read failures and selected setting arguments.
files.why: Read requests and settings argv need exact host/context and side-effect boundaries.
files.when: Changing repository read helpers or setting discovery.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_repository.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Exercise default file browsing, settings confirmation and stale repository reads.
files.why: User actions must preserve the resolved target and cancel without mutations.
files.when: Changing files and settings UI or worker lifecycle.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_repository_panel.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Exercise literal argv, context, child exit status, cancellation, timeout and UTF-8 capture.
files.why: Fixture Python children verify process behavior without GitHub side effects.
files.when: Changing process execution, environment controls or bounded output handling.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_runner.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.

files.purpose: Verify all twelve common command buttons and hotkeys, confirmations and responsive layout.
files.why: Git and GitHub shortcuts must retain explicit execution and the correct context.
files.when: Changing quick commands, hotkeys, busy guards or Git menu entries.
files.how_to_edit: Run uv run pytest tests/test_shortcuts.py; full gates: uv run pytest, uv run ruff check ., uv build.
